name: Subscription audit
audience: Anyone who wants to see streaming, apps, gym fees, and box deliveries in one list.
summary: List recurring charges, mark what you will cancel, and total the annual saving.
description: Every row is a subscription or membership. Decision must be Keep or Cancel. Annual cost is monthly times 12. The summary adds the cancel rows.
benefits: Turn monthly charges into an annual number
Mark a decision instead of vaguely meaning to cancel
See the saving only from rows you marked Cancel
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
